changelog:
v4.4.2:
- CRITICAL FIX: Fixed infinite update loop — module.prop was not bumped in v4.4.1, causing Magisk to perpetually detect an available update.
- Improved update check: now only prompts when a strictly newer version is available (was using != comparison).
- Synced all version strings across module.prop, build.gradle, customize.sh, and service.sh.
